method: Proposed controlled installation sequence, not an instruction to start construction

holdpoints.evidence: Accepted control, locates, approved limits, drainage/formation design and permits.
holdpoints.crew_scope: Farm crew can clear/stage/assist only within released limits; no earthwork from a synthetic sample.

holdpoints.evidence: As-built formation, drainage elevations/outfalls, compaction/moisture evidence and disposition.
holdpoints.crew_scope: Crew performs released work and records materials/locations; specialist accepts hidden work before cover.

holdpoints.evidence: Coordinated rail/wheel profile, approved ties/spacing/fastenings/joints/ballast and curve/turnout details, traceable rail condition.
holdpoints.crew_scope: Crew may assemble to released details under track-specialist setup/training; matching nominal gauge is insufficient.

holdpoints.evidence: Controlled gauge/alignment/elevations, ties/fastenings, joints, ballast and drainage; correct measuring references and instrument checks.
holdpoints.crew_scope: Crew records every adjusted location; no invented allowable gauge, cant, twist or curve radius.

holdpoints.evidence: Loaded/unloaded floor motion, stopping/lateral envelope, actual bridge/lift bearing and retention, settlement and escape route.
holdpoints.crew_scope: Coordinate station work with vehicle—not a frozen32in study floor.

holdpoints.evidence: Accepted track inspection and controlled test plan, exclusion zone, loads, speeds, failure/stop cases and emergency response.
holdpoints.crew_scope: No passenger proving runs or fabricated acceptance values. Track, train and stations must be accepted as a system.

not_training_manual: Keep separate rail-installation training Site unchanged; these are project-specific interface/release requirements.
